sentence_stem: Even though the train was late,
correct_completion: we arrived at the meeting on time.
full_sentence: Even though the train was late, we arrived at the meeting on time.
acceptable_variants: we still reached the meeting before it started.
we managed to be punctual for the meeting.

options.text: so we missed the meeting completely.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result that follows naturally, not a contrast. 'Even though' needs an outcome that goes against the expected result.

options.text: we had booked the wrong seats.
options.why_wrong: This adds a separate problem and does not complete the contrast that 'even though' introduces.

options.text: we arrived at the meeting on time.
the train had been delayed twice before.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the cause of the delay instead of giving the contrasting outcome expected after 'even though'.

explanation: Concessive connectors introduce a clause that contrasts with the main clause, so the completion must show an unexpected outcome. Turkish speakers may focus on the delay and choose a result or cause clause, because Turkish often marks this kind of contrast with a different grammatical pattern.
translation: Tren gecikmiş olmasına rağmen toplantıya zamanında vardık.
